scenario.note: The objective maximizes sugar beet grown while maintaining non-negative yearly profit across all five years, preserving the total five-year profit at its original level.
The objective is maximized subject to the total profit over five years being zero, ensuring the five-year profit is fully intact while maximizing sugar beet grown.
The first stage maximizes the total profit over five years, preserving the original objective. The second stage maximizes sugar beet sales across all years, subject to the first stage's optimum.
The first objective maximises total profit (original objective), then the second maximises total sugar beet sold across all years, subject to the first objective being unchanged at its optimal value.
